acceptance_criterion: Only the coordinator assigned to the event can raise a booking request for that event
test_name: refuses anyone but the event's assigned coordinator, storing nothing (L1-T11)

acceptance_criterion: The request records venue, date, start and end time, room layout, expected attendance, and the required facilities and accessibility features
test_name: stores a Pending request with every detail, its coordinator, time and a BKR reference (L1-T1, L1-T2)

acceptance_criterion: The date, times, and expected attendance default from the event record; if the coordinator changes any of them, the request is flagged as differing from the event and the differing values are shown to Venue Staff
test_name: flags a request whose times or attendance differ from the event's, with each value (L1-T3, L1-T4)

acceptance_criterion: On success the request is stored with status Pending and records the requesting coordinator, the timestamp, and a unique booking reference
test_name: gives every request its own reference

acceptance_criterion: The request appears in the queue for that venue's Venue Staff, appears as pending on the availability calendar, and triggers a notification to the venue's staff
test_name: shows Venue Staff the pending requests for their own venues only, differences included (L1-T5, L1-T4)

acceptance_criterion: A second pending request for the same event, venue, and overlapping period is refused, naming the existing pending booking reference
test_name: refuses a second pending request for the same event, venue and an overlapping period, naming the first (L1-T8)

acceptance_criterion: CR-03: an event may have booking requests for several venues at the same time (L4); each is decided separately
test_name: allows the same period at another venue, and another event's request for the same venue (L1-T9)

acceptance_criterion: CR-02: a request raised to replace a disrupted booking is linked to that booking (L5)
test_name: links a replacement to the event's disrupted booking, and refuses any other booking (L1-T10)

acceptance_criterion: A refused request creates no booking record and changes no venue availability
test_name: refuses invalid fields, naming each, and stores nothing (L1-T12)
